problem_statement: OpenThread needs a bit-utility helper that, given a 32-bit unsigned integer value, returns the minimum number of bits required to represent it. The convention must be that a value of 0 requires 1 bit (not 0); 1 returns 1; 2 and 3 return 2; 4..7 return 3; 8..15 return 4; 16..31 return 5; 32..127 return 7; 128..255 return 8; 256..511 return 9; 1000..1023 return 10; 1024..2000 return 11; 0xffff returns 16; 0x10000 returns 17; 0x7fffffff returns 31; and both 0x80000000 and 0xffffffff return 32.
